title: World Taiwan Foundation 世台聯合基金會
content_html: World Taiwan Foundation is an NGO that supports international charity work across five continents and 27 countries. It focuses on four major areas: Disaster Relief, Culture and Education, Public Health, and Environmental Protection. The organization creates sustainable change by connecting and collaborating with NGOs, NPOs, government departments, UN agencies, and the corporate sector to maximize the impact of charitable donations.
